name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx for three SSL-enabled static sites, including virtual hosts, document roots, TLS, redirects, security headers, logging, Fail2ban, firewall rules, SSH hardening, and sysctl hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, configures Redis authentication and logging, and applies the cookbook's Redis post-configuration adjustments.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, deploys the FastAPI application from GitHub in a virtual environment, provisions its database and user, and runs it through systemd.
